programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Montana Grizzlies (7-3, 5-2 Big Sky) host the Idaho State Bengals (6-4, 3-4 Big Sky) at Washington-Grizzly Stadium. Idaho State hopes to bounce back after a 28-26 3OT loss against Montana State, while Montana aims for a three-game win streak.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The TCU Horned Frogs (4-5, 2-4 Big 12) host the Kansas State Wildcats (4-5, 1-5 Big 12) at Amon G. Carter Stadium in Fort Worth. Kansas State hopes to break a three-game skid behind Avery Johnson, while TCU relies on Jaden Craig to find momentum.

programme.title: Live: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 7 Hurricanes (8-1, 6-0 ACC) try to recover as they host the Blue Devils (7-2, 4-2). Miami, which is without star wideout Malachi Toney, lost 31-24 at Notre Dame last week. Duke has won three straight after dismantling NC State, 41-3.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 1 Georgia Bulldogs (8-1, 6-1 SEC) host the No. 22 Missouri Tigers (6-3, 3-3 SEC) at Sanford Stadium. Georgia aims for a three-game win streak behind quarterback Gunner Stockton, while Missouri hopes to bounce back after 34-20 loss to Texas.

programme.title: College Football Live
programme.desc: Want to know up-to-the-minute reports about your favorite college football team? ESPN has it covered with this weekday studio show, a roundtable format that emphasizes discussion and opinions on the sport's biggest stories and newsmakers.
